description: Use this when the buyer asks about 1 to 5 named products: plan prices, free plan, AI assistant or MCP support, whether they work with tools already in use, or what changed recently, e.g. 'Does Pipedrive work with Gmail?'. Do not use for setup, troubleshooting or choosing between products.

budget.description: Use free when only Free-plan integrations count.

existing_tools.description: Software the buyer already uses, to check named integrations; for example Gmail and Notion.

seat_count.description: Paid seats, to show team price subtotals.

name: check_software
title: Check facts about named software
